help.label: Maps help
help.grid: Each square is one cell of the Build {build} world (B42 cells are 256 tiles, B41 cells 300, so only one build's maps compare). Grey is the game's own map, teal its river; blue is a cell one map fills, gold a map built over a vanilla area (usually on purpose), red two or more maps fighting over a cell: only one of them loads there. Per-map colours give each shown map its own hue instead.
help.preview: Enabled maps are always shown. Tick a map, or click its row, to preview it: it's drawn and checked for conflicts, but nothing changes in your mod list until you enable it. Click cells to list the maps there; Shift+click adds more cells.
help.workshop: With Workshop maps on, PZMM lists every Map-tagged Workshop item for this build, including ones you haven't installed: at once from its built-in index, then it reads the file lists of items updated since from Steam (no download, nothing installed), reading an item again only when it's updated. Paste a collection in "Check a Workshop map" to preview all its maps. Preview them like installed maps, then Install the ones you want.

check.versionFolderName: {folder}/ looks like a version folder, but the game only reads 42, 42.x and common/
check.noModInfo: no mod.info: the game won't see this folder as a mod

check.noCommon: no common/ folder: Build 42's layout has one beside the version folders (it can be empty), and some game versions skip a mod without it
check.noVersionFolder: only common/: Build 42 normally reads mod.info from a version folder such as 42/
check.versionBelow42: version folders are a Build 42 feature: Build 41 never reads this one
check.versionNoInfo: no mod.info here: Build 42 won't load this version folder
check.infoInCommon: the game ignores mod.info in common/: each version folder needs its own
check.rootMedia: Build 42 ignores media/ at the mod's top level: move it into common/ or a version folder
check.outsideMedia: {folder}/ belongs inside media/: the game doesn't look for it here
check.fileType: the Workshop uploader refuses .exe, .dll, .bat, .sh, .so, .dylib, .app and .zip files (pyramid.zip aside)
check.badLine: line {line} isn't key=value: the game skips it
check.spaceBeforeEquals: "{key} =": the game only reads {key}= with no space before the =
check.wrongCase: {key}= is ignored: keys are case-sensitive, write {right}=
check.duplicateKey: {key}= is set more than once: only one counts
check.idChars: id={id} has characters that break mod lists (\ / , ; ")
check.missingFile: {key}={path}: no such file beside this mod.info (or in common/)
check.notPng: {key}={path}: posters and icons should be PNG
check.separator: {key}=: separate mod ids with commas, the game doesn't split on ;
check.noBackslash41: {key}={item}: Build 41 doesn't use the \ before mod ids
check.badVersion: {key}={value} isn't a version the game reads (like 42.0 or 41.78.16)
check.tiledefFormat: tiledef= needs a file name and a number
check.noName: no name=: the mod shows up without a name
check.noId: no id=: the game can't load it, and other mods can't require it
check.noDescription: no description=: the in-game mod list shows none
check.minAboveMax: versionMin is above versionMax: no game version can load it
check.maxBelow42: versionMax is below 42 in a Build 42 folder: Build 42 won't load it
check.noTitle: no title=: the uploader won't go on without one
check.titleLong: the title is over 128 characters: Steam cuts it
check.descriptionLong: the description is over 8000 characters: Steam refuses it
check.badVisibility: visibility={value} isn't one the game knows (public, friendsOnly, private, unlisted)
check.badId: id={value} isn't a Workshop item number
check.unknownTag: {tag} isn't one of the game's Workshop tags
check.noPreview: no preview.png: the Workshop needs a 256×256 PNG
check.previewFormat: not a PNG the uploader can read
check.previewBig: over 1000 KB: the uploader refuses it
check.noContents: no Contents/ folder: the uploader needs your mod in Contents/mods/
check.folderInContents: Contents/ may only hold buildings/, creative/ and mods/
check.fileInMods: Contents/mods/ may only hold mod folders
